about: Outages, failed deploys and data faults of kolaboro.com, newest first. Deploy guard results from /data/deploys.json, synthetic monitoring from /data/monitoring.json, and incidents written up in our engineering notes. Times UTC; end null = still open.

incidents.what: After Brotli copies of /data/*.json were switched on, the worker's own reads of /data/bali-cases.json got the compressed copy: every /api/open/* endpoint answered data_unavailable (08:47 to 08:53). For about 5 minutes after that fix, browsers got some JSON files compressed twice.
incidents.impact: Open data API down for 6 minutes; some JSON downloads unreadable for about 5 more minutes. HTML pages stayed up.
incidents.fix: Worker reads take the plain copy (9d9c5759c3), then Brotli copies switched off (35a21e3f9e). They stay off; a test header keeps the path testable.

incidents.what: A trailing comment swallowed the rest of a line in the sitemap builder ("T is not defined"): /sitemap_index.xml, every /sitemaps/*.xml and /engineering/seo/ answered 500.
incidents.impact: Sitemaps unavailable to search engines for about 7 minutes. Pages stayed up.
incidents.fix: Line restored (13098cd3d2); all sitemaps 200 again with the same URL counts.

incidents.what: The edge worker directory passed the 25 MiB limit of Cloudflare Pages, so every build of the publishing branch failed (about 60 sites on that branch).
incidents.impact: No new version could go live for about 50 minutes; visitors kept getting the previous version.
incidents.fix: Large string tables moved out of the worker into static JSON (019b1a96b1, then batch 32 lowered the worker from 24.50 to 22.40 MiB); a size guard now stops a push above the limit.

incidents.what: The daily dataset snapshot job stopped adding entries after 17 Nov ("chain broken at 2026-11-07"): a full-history clone saw days before the chain start.
incidents.impact: No signed daily snapshot for 18, 19 and 20 Nov until they were added by hand on 21 Nov; the published chain stayed verifiable.
incidents.fix: Entries 18 to 20 Nov added from the fixed script on 21 Nov; the script fix for the scheduled job is waiting to be merged, so this stays open.

incidents.what: 5 pushed commits not live within 12 minutes (deploy guard).
incidents.impact: None for visitors: the previous version stayed live; most were replaced by a newer push before their build finished.
incidents.fix: No action needed; the newer commits went live and passed the checks.
